evals.prompt: Write `objectstack.config.ts` for our CRM app: objects, views and flows under src/, namespace `crm`, protocol 18.
evals.expected_output: `defineStack` with a `manifest` of `id`, `version`, `type: 'app'`, `name`, `namespace: 'crm'`, `engines: { protocol: '^18' }`; barrel imports, `objects: Object.values(objects)` (likewise `views` / `flows`); prefixed object names (`crm_account`), no object-level `namespace`, no `tableName`; no driver in `plugins:` (the CLI resolves it); no `workflows` / `approvals` keys (refused).

evals.prompt: Build a plugin registering an `audit` service that records every metadata reload and every `task` insert.
evals.expected_output: A `Plugin` with `name`, `init(ctx)` calling `ctx.registerService('audit', ...)` and `ctx.hook('metadata:reloaded', ...)`, `start(ctx)`, `destroy()`. Record events are not kernel hooks — a `data:*` kernel hook registers and never fires — so the task insert is a data hook (objectstack-data). No install / enable / disable hooks.

evals.prompt: Our scheduled flows never launch, and `notify` reports success but nobody receives anything.
evals.expected_output: `requires: ['automation', 'triggers', 'job', 'messaging']` on the stack root: `triggers` alone arms record-change triggers, schedule and time-relative ones run on the `job` service, and without `messaging` notify returns success with `skipped: true`. Declaring is a demand (missing provider = hard boot error); `defineStack` rejects an unknown token at authoring time.

evals.prompt: We deploy on Vercel serverless functions in our own Hono app; mount the ObjectStack API under /api.
evals.expected_output: `createHonoApp({ kernel })` from `@objectstack/hono` (prefix defaults to `/api`) in the host app — `HonoServerPlugin` only when ObjectStack owns the server; `LiteKernel` for a cold-start-sensitive host; `/auth/*` follows the auth `basePath`, not `prefix`; no `adapter-*` packages exist.

evals.prompt: I changed field types on an object with production data. Show me what the database needs, verify the metadata and give me a quality score.
evals.expected_output: `os migrate plan` previews the drift, `os migrate apply` (`--allow-destructive` for type changes / drops) reconciles, then `os validate` and `os lint --score`; not done until `os validate` passes, which `os lint` does not replace.

evals.prompt: Plan the production deployment: Docker on Kubernetes behind nginx, PostgreSQL.
evals.expected_output: `os start` as the entrypoint, `PORT` pinned (production fails loudly on a busy port), `driver-sql` by database URL (no `DriverPlugin` in `plugins:`), TLS on the proxy, app on an internal port, `OS_AUTH_URL` / `OS_TRUSTED_ORIGINS` / app `hostname` in sync; health: `GET /health`, `GET /ready`.

evals.prompt: Prepare a demo of our contracts app: the seed assigns matters to 'Legal Counsel 1' and 'Paralegal 1', and the demo opens signed in as Legal Counsel 1.
evals.expected_output: Both go in `demoStaff` — `name` as the seed references them, `email`, a `position` / `permissionSets` the stack declares — and `os dev` creates the accounts with the seed password: no `password` key, no `role` alias, no platform set, no hand-written `sys_user` seed row. `devLogins` creates nothing (at most a banner entry); `os build` drops `demoStaff`; production creates no demo account.

evals.prompt: In the contracts demo Paralegal 1 reports to Legal Counsel 1; the approval flow's manager step must reach the right person on a fresh `os dev`.
evals.expected_output: On Paralegal 1's `demoStaff` entry, `manager: 'counsel1@example.com'` — Legal Counsel 1's entry `email`, never the display name — and nothing else: `os dev` writes `sys_user.manager_id` once every demo account exists. No seed row or hook writing `manager_id`, no `reportsTo` / `managerEmail` alias (refused); a manager naming no entry, itself or a loop is refused at load.

evals.prompt: Add a `support_intake` queue staffed by the `service_agent` position and route every new `crm_case` into it (`requires: ['automation', 'triggers']`).
evals.expected_output: Two stack collections: `queues: [defineQueue({ name: 'support_intake', label: 'Support Intake', members: [{ type: 'position', value: 'service_agent' }] })]` and `assignmentRules: [defineAssignmentRule(...)]` with one entry, `assignTo: { type: 'queue', value: 'support_intake' }`; plus `'sharing'` in `requires`: the keys need `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`'s ownership-queue service (`queue` is the job queue), else the boot is refused.

evals.prompt: We installed HotCRM (`hotcrm`, version 3.2.0). Replace its `crm_account_grid` list view with our own columns so every read of that view serves ours, and keep the change exportable to staging.
evals.expected_output: The whole view, under the same name `crm_account_grid`, authored in HotCRM's paired writable package `hotcrm.custom` (which depends on `hotcrm`) with `overrides: { package: 'hotcrm', basedOn: '3.2.0' }` in its body — the base's `manifest.id` and `manifest.version`, `basedOn` recorded and never judged. Every read of the name (no `?package`, `?package=hotcrm`, the layered read, both lists) then serves it under `_packageId: 'hotcrm'`, and `GET /packages/hotcrm.custom/export` carries it with the declaration. Not an in-place edit of HotCRM's own read-only item, not a package-unbound Setup row (that path wins only until the D11 migration), not an object extension (that adds fields and replaces no view), and no declaration from any other package (ignored).
